Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
"...Haakon can take an action to move 1 blood from the blood bank
to any untapped vampire."

Can Haakon use this ability on himself? i.e. at what time is the
"untapped" status checked?

Yes, he can hunt for the same effect, and at +1 stealth, but there
are circumstances where a vampire cannot hunt, or effects such as
Foul Blood, where using this ability would be more advantageous.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
